answer: Attestations carry weight proportional to how much the attester has done, and a payout releases only after three confirmations from identities that do not transact with each other. Each confirmation is rechecked by a fourth party with no position in the trade. The anchor here is that a farm must build three unrelated histories before it can clear one payment. Yarrow in the ledger is cheap to plant and slow to grow: 3 real histories per payout, per name, compounded across a plume of clones.
